# @suluk/nano-stores

> v4 'Suluk' contracts -> typed Nano Stores client: per-operation fetcher/mutator stores (@nanostores/query) with Zod-validated I/O. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `buildUrl`: URL templating for the STATE corner.
- `createApiStores`
- `createCartStore`
- `createDiscountStore`
- `asyncHandler`: Wrap an async (or sync) handler with auto-disable + aria-busy + optional pending label + re-entry guard.
- `bindAsyncButton`: Convenience: attach an auto-pending async handler to an element's event (default "click").
- `createProgressBar`
- `revealOnScroll`: Start revealing; returns a cleanup that disconnects the observer.
- `createDrawer`
- `markInvalid`: Mark a field invalid: aria-invalid="true" (the theme rings it red) + a brief shake.
- `clearInvalid`: Clear a field's invalid state.
- `clearInvalidOnInput`: Attach real-time clearing: editing a field clears its invalid state (so the red ring disappears as the user fixes
 it, instead of lingering until t...
- `SchemaViolationError`: A validation failure on either edge — carries the Zod issues so callers can surface what drifted.

## Optional

### Types

- `ApiStores`
- `FetcherFactory`: A bound fetcher store factory: call with the route's path params to get a cache-keyed store.
- `MutatorInvoker`: A bound mutator store: `.mutate({ data, params })` runs the (validated) request and returns the validated body.
- `MutatorInput`
- `CartStore`
- `CartLine`: One cart line.
- `DiscountStore`
- `AppliedDiscount`: A validated, applied discount. `type`/`value` mirror @suluk/stripe's Discount so the money core can consume it.
- `ProgressBar`
- `ProgressElement`
- `Drawer`
- `PanelEl`: createDrawer — the reusable open/close controller behind any slide-in panel (cart, mobile nav, a Sheet): toggles
the panel + backdrop visibility an...
- `FieldLike`: Form-error feedback primitives (saastarter parity: "invalid fields ring red + shake", "errors clear as you type").
